description: This file contains tests for node matching functions such as normalizeNodeKey, resolveNodeMatches, and resolveNodeIdFromCandidates, focusing on node identification, matching heuristics, and error handling within a networked node management system.

methods.name: normalizeNodeKey
methods.description: Normalizes a node key by lowercasing and collapsing separators.

methods.name: resolveNodeMatches
methods.description: Resolves node matches based on various identifiers and normalization.

methods.name: resolveNodeIdFromCandidates
methods.description: Resolves a node ID from a list of candidates, with disambiguation logic and error reporting.
